title: Fixed Two-Wheel and Parked-Lance Pressure Washer
description: One newly authored whole static upright pressure-washer appearance. A chamfered tall motor housing and upper control panel stand on a broad front foot and two large rear wheels joined by a common axle. An actual open pulling handle rises from the back. A continuous curved exterior hose joins a lower front coupling to the grip of a parked long lance, which is retained by two finite side brackets. A separate trigger, collar and blunt nozzle complete the fixed exterior. Three opaque PBR roles; one prop, zero scenes. No water, live outlet, pressure, pump internals, cleaning operation, electrical or engineering/safety claim. Not a recoloured backpack sprayer or four-caster vacuum. All geometry newly authored; no old visible mesh payload imported.
